requiredFindings.title: Contract successor omits passage overrides for the PlatformProfileSetV1 sentences
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Decision 7 gives the contract successor a V2 schema, a V2 reference, and new cases, and leaves §S8 lines 685 and 711 and the envelope-kind sentence at line 845 naming only PlatformProfileSetV1. A reader that follows those sentences treats a profileSetSchema 2 body as the wrong type, so the opt-in V2 set is outside the selected profile-set description. The successor needs passage overrides that cover V2 under domain opensip.metadata.platform-profile-set.1 and the optional macOS measured-row member.

scope: Law 458b r1: closed PlatformProfileSetV2 with reader opt-in for installAclOmission. Not Evidence B.
